blockingIssues.description: `handlers/request-processor.ts` still returns plain objects cast as `Response` for live STT validation/error branches, so invalid-audio, empty-transcript, and text-too-long paths still do not produce real HTTP `Response` instances.
The live ai-gateway response still omits compatibility fields `stt_latency_ms`, `tts_generation_ms`, and `tts_skipped_reason`, even though the client and response-mapping tests still consume them.
VAL-BE-030 still fails because `context/farm-data.ts` (1664 lines), `routing/router.ts` (1406 lines), and legacy `voice-routing.ts` (1364 lines) remain over the 500-line limit.
The extracted handler modules are still not the live request path: `handlers/main.ts` keeps clarify/voice-log logic inline and still has no `farm_query` dispatch branch.
`MAX_AUDIO_BASE64_LENGTH` is still too small for some exact-10MB payloads, so valid boundary-size uploads can still be rejected as `AUDIO_TOO_LARGE`.
The shared circuit breaker still decays cumulative failures instead of resetting on success, so Sarvam STT can still open after non-consecutive failures rather than five consecutive failures.

Blank OpenAI STT results still miss the required HTTP 400 `EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT` path because the OpenAI empty-transcript error string does not match the `stt_empty_transcript` sentinel normalized by `processStt()`.
When the Sarvam TTS circuit is open, `generateSpeech()` still falls through to OpenAI even when `providerFallbackEnabled` is false.
`__tests__/tts-provider.test.ts` still never imports or executes `generateSpeech()`, so the TTS provider behavior is still not verified by real module tests.
`__tests__/llm-provider.test.ts` still does not import or execute `chatCompletion()` or `extractIntent()`, so GPT-4o-mini advisory and JSON-mode extraction remain unverified.

`__tests__/embeddings-provider.test.ts` still does not import or execute `generateEmbedding()` or the real shared memory/RAG embedding path, so the single-embedding behavior is still not behaviorally verified.
Attendance access still only activates for literal `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, so prompts like 'today' or local-language equivalents still bypass `worker_attendance` queries.
The attendance query is still not tenant-scoped when `farmId` is omitted, so it can read other tenants' attendance rows for the same day.

Weather enrichment still trusts arbitrary `farmId` values and still falls back to hard-coded Nashik coordinates when farm coordinates are missing, instead of skipping unauthorized or irrelevant weather context.

`decideChatRoute()` and clarification can still resolve to `farm_query`, but the live dispatch block in `handlers/main.ts` never calls `handleFarmQuery()`, so deterministic farm-query handling remains unreachable.

Legacy `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/voice-routing.ts` still exists alongside `routing/router.ts`, and `handlers/main.ts` still duplicates clarify/voice-log routing inline, so the routing refactor remains duplicated and monolithic.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to note that the repo still lacks a backend test covering the live `handlers/main.ts` ai-gateway dispatch path, so unreachable backend routes can slip past currently green Jest coverage.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require backend tests to import and execute the real exported module under test (or a documented adapter/harness for Deno edge modules). Helper-only, literal-only, or copy-pasted tests should not satisfy tests-first requirements.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-3 reviews for be-modular-structure, be-stt-provider-upgrade, be-tts-provider, be-llm-provider, and be-context-assembly all found green Jest files that still never executed the real ai-gateway provider/context modules they claimed to validate.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Derive verification commands from `.factory/services.yaml` instead of prescribing `npm test -- --grep ...`, and generate feature verification steps that match the repo's actual Jest invocation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-3 reviews for be-tts-provider, be-llm-provider, and be-routing-and-handlers all found repo guidance still pointing workers to `npm test -- --grep ...` even though `.factory/services.yaml` defines the canonical test command as raw Jest with ignore patterns.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` to be false whenever documented tests-first or module-size rules were violated.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Round-3 reviews for be-modular-structure and be-routing-and-handlers both found prior handoffs claiming `followedProcedure: true` despite empty `tests.added` arrays and ai-gateway modules that still exceed the 500-line limit.

rejectedObservations.observation: Multiple reviews separately reported placeholder backend tests that never execute real modules.
Update `.factory/services.yaml` to fix the backend test-command mismatch.
